title: Create a song
intro: A blank project that already sounds like you: one track per role taken from your own projects (instrument, effects, presets), and a structure taken from yours. Every draw is different; keep what you like and reroll the rest. Your original projects are only read.
name: Name
usualBpm: {bpm} bpm if you change nothing: your usual tempo in {style}.
rerollTitle: Redraw the tracks you haven't kept, and the structure
dest: The project will be written here
newFolder: A new folder, in Live {v} format. Nothing existing is changed.
liveHint: A track can only be added to a project of the same format. By default: your most recent version.
structDrawn: drawn from {n} structures in your {style} projects
markers: Laid out as locators in the project: no clips, no automation.
chooseChain: Choose another chain for this role
rerollPartTitle: Another chain for this role only
keptTitle: Kept: a new draw leaves it alone (click to release it)
keepTitle: Keep this chain for the next draw
noChain: No chain for this role loads in Live {v}.
